findings: The implementation agrees with the independent 72-point prototype within 1.3e-3 rad in every selected case (36 orbit points).

A classical saddle was previously reported as no_degeneracy (classical softness = inf when a non-orbit Hessian mode is negative). Two cases: tilted V (0.1) refined from phi = 0 stops at a symmetric saddle; the Y angles at 20 h refine to the collinear up-up-down saddle (E = -0.210 against -0.444 for the polarized state), which the old polarized-state test accepted for the wrong reason. Both are now not_soft with the message that the input is not a classical minimum.
V at 5.7 degrees (tilt 0.1): not_soft from either start; the orbit is not a soft coordinate (prototype adiabatic ratio 5.6e3).
